article.title: Stock specifically bequeathed sold but replaced, and belonging to testator at his death.
article.content: Where stock specifically bequeathed is sold, and an equal quantity of the same stock is afterwards purchased and belongs to the testator at his death, the legacy is not adeemed.
article.html:
166Stock specifically bequeathed sold but replaced, and belonging to testator at his death.

Section 166 · Part VI · Chapter XVI · page 58 of the Act

Where stock specifically bequeathed is sold, and an equal quantity of the same stock is afterwards purchased and belongs to the testator at his death, the legacy is not adeemed.
